cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put a tick beside yours on the museum form. Landing approved for Monday's opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My tick means missing. There's nothing supporting your invisible landing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Missing structure noted. We've budgeted enough confidence to hold twenty visitors. Will you certify that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How am I supposed to certify confidence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign under 'load-bearing'. Your professional certainty will support the inspectors too.
